limitations: Stable Rust 1.93.0/1.93.1 little-endian 64-bit fmt layout only; executed native producer is 1.93.1.
Only exact panic_fmt identities, constant mapped nonvolatile caller-location addresses and supported literal/integer templates qualify.
Recovered source supplies its own panic location and backtrace; original location fields are not reproduced.
Primitive execution uses unchanged macro expressions with explicit typed input bindings; complete descriptor setup is retained and is not universally recompilable.
Full angr Go/Rust parity is not established by this change.
